The /live/export/insights API provides a response in the following format:

200 Success

LiveInsightExportRow Model - Insight row of a live deployment export.
project_id integer
Id of the project.
deploy_id integer
Internal id of the live deployment. It isn't the deployment Id that starts with L-.
insight_id string
Id of the insight.
source string
example: live trading
Source of the insight.
source_model string
Name of the Alpha model that emitted the insight.
symbol_id string
example: SPY R735QTJ8XC9X
Id of the Symbol.
ticker string
Ticker of the Symbol.
symbol_market string
example: usa
Market of the Symbol.
security_type string
example: Equity
Security type of the Symbol.
type string Enum
Type of the insight. Options : ['price', 'volatility']
direction string Enum
Direction of the insight. Options : ['up', 'flat', 'down']
period integer
Period of the insight in seconds.
magnitude number
Predicted magnitude of the change.
confidence number
Confidence of the insight.
weight number
Weight of the insight.
group_id string
Id of the insight group.
generated_time string
example: 2026-01-29 05:00:00
Time when the algorithm emitted the insight, in UTC.
close_time string
example: 2026-01-30 05:00:00
Time when the insight expires, in UTC.
received_time string
Time when the insight was received, in UTC.
reference_value number
Price of the Symbol when the algorithm emitted the insight.
reference_value_final integer
1 if the reference value is final, otherwise 0.
estimated_value number
Estimated value of the insight.
score_direction number
Direction score of the insight.
score_magnitude number
Magnitude score of the insight.
score_final integer
1 if the scores are final, otherwise 0.
invalid integer
1 if the insight is invalid, otherwise 0.
in_storage integer
Internal storage flag.
Example 
[
  {
    "project_id": 0,
    "deploy_id": 0,
    "insight_id": "string",

401 Authentication Error

UnauthorizedError Model - Unauthorized response from the API. Key is missing, invalid, or timestamp is too old for hash.
www_authenticate string
Header
